JPMorgan.description: JPMorgan ETF. A single-file client-side tool reading ./api/jpmorgan (JPMorgan ETF explorer, product-data and historical-data JSON, SEC EDGAR and Yahoo Finance fallbacks) into a searchable ETF/asset-class catalog with per-fund tabs, watchlist, CSV/TXT export. TailwindCSS, dark mode, Bun updater.

iShares.description: iShares ETF. A single-file client-side tool reading ./api/ishares (iShares official Data Download workbooks and Yahoo Finance history) into a searchable ETF/asset-class catalog with per-fund tabs, watchlist, CSV/TXT export. TailwindCSS, dark mode, Bun updater.

aberdeen.description: abrdn ETF. A single-file client-side tool reading ./api/aberdeen (official Aberdeen gateway, SEC EDGAR N-PORT-P holdings fallback and Yahoo Finance history/dividends) into a searchable ETF/asset-class catalog with per-fund tabs, watchlist, CSV/TXT export. TailwindCSS, dark mode, Bun updater.
